name: io.github.JayPokale/farmout
title: farmout
description: Hand work to the AI subscriptions you already pay for: Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, local models

environmentVariables.name: FARMOUT_CLAUDE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Config dir of a second Claude Code account (enables the claude worker)

environmentVariables.name: FARMOUT_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL ending in /v1 (enables the api worker with FARMOUT_API_MODEL)

environmentVariables.name: FARMOUT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for FARMOUT_API_BASE, if it needs one
